text.text_excerpt: Easy 5 stars. I don't even have to think about it, but I do have this burning need to let on to my fellow yelpers as to why Wayfare warrants such accolades! Enter the warmly lit double storefront restaurant and order your food at the counter. Generally, I prefer getting full service where a server takes care of you from start to finish. But wait! This is not a criticism of Wayfare, because if every restaurant was able to handle the whole "order at the counter" thing with as much aplomb, I'd be more inclined to like it. They are fucking pros! You walk in, you're greeted. There's no lingering in the doorway, no searching for the hostess, waitress, bartender to lead the way (this actually ha...

I've been to Wayfare a few times now and have had pleasant and satisfying experiences always. I've had good luck with the service and I really enjoy the atmosphere. It's a clean and bright space. The food is good. Last night I tried the caprese sandwich and was really impressed. This was a caprese with a twist. The sandwich was filled fresh house-made mozzarella, pesto, tomato, and some type of aioli that added a lot to the overall taste. I've gotten the tomato soup a few times. It's alright, but a little on the salty side and nothing to rave about. The brussel sprout appetizer is one of my favorite things on the menu! They're cooked perfectly and tossed in a sweet Asian glaze. Highly rec...

Second time I've been here because I know this place will always be a crowd pleaser with its simple elegant take on salads and sandwiches. We had a party of 12 of a rainy weeknight and were easily accommodated, but I still have them a heads up right before we left. We had one server for our whole table, but he did a great job with being attentive and not obtrusive. I ordered the pork belly old fashioned, which was one of the best new kind of old fashioneds that I've had bc it was really smooth with a hint of smoke and a great balance of citrus and acidity.
